module: "Ring" checkpoint marker: a 3D ring (checkpoint_ring.dae, or checkpoint_ring_finish.dae for the lap and final modes) oriented along the checkpoint normal and colored according to the mode, with a 0.3 s fade between two modes. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/ringMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: Colors per mode: default red (1, 0.07, 0), next black, start and lap green (0.4, 1, 0.2), final blue (0.1, 0.3, 1), branch orange (1, 0.6, 0), hidden black (fades out then hidden).
setToCheckpoint(wp) reads wp.pos, wp.radius, wp.normal (ring direction), wp.up (vec3, default 0,0,1) and wp.mode (chooses the model).
In setToCheckpoint the scale is radius+1.5, but update brings it back to radius: the difference only lasts for the first frame.
The extracted page shows update(dtSim); the actual signature is update(dt, dtSim).

init.desc: Constructor: initializes the state and copies the mode table.

update.desc: Per-frame call: advances the color fade, hides the ring once in 'hidden' mode, updates scale and color.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places the ring (position, model according to wp.mode, rotation) on a checkpoint.

setMode.desc: Switches to a mode: shows (except 'hidden'), starts the color fade from the old mode and changes the model.

mode.desc: default, next, start, lap, final, branch or hidden.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates the ring.
